clips.title: The story
paras: Mennet Carkad is an introductory rogue quest in the Undercity that brings promising operatives into the fold of the Deathstalkers. Directed by Marion Call, aspiring assassins are summoned to report directly to Mennet Carkad deep within the Rogues' Quarter.

Within the dark corridors of the Undercity, word travels quietly among the Forsaken's covert operatives. When a scout or assassin catches the eye of the higher leadership, an invitation is issued. Marion Call passes down word that Mennet Carkad, a prominent figure among the rogue handlers, has taken personal notice. Given the lethal reputation of the Forsaken intelligence apparatus, ignoring such a directive is not considered a viable option.

Mennet Carkad waits in the shadowy alcoves of the Rogues' Quarter, watching over recruits and evaluating their readiness. Those who heed his call are not simply joining an ordinary guild of thieves; they are being tested for entry into the Deathstalkers, the dreaded espionage and assassination arm of the Forsaken. Swift obedience is merely the first baseline test for anyone seeking to serve the Dark Lady from the shadows.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend? Not quite what I was expecting, considering Carkad himself has taken an interest to you. Looks can be deceiving though, right?
Either way, you should go see him as soon as possible. You wouldn't want to know what happened to the last few that chose to ignore his summons.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hm. No doubt you made your way here at first mention of my summons, yes? Of course. I would expect no less from a prospective Deathstalker.
